title: Beachside Bliss To Phuket And Koh Samui
highlights: Enjoy the best of Thailand, the Land of Smiles and make memories as you visit some of the most amazing cities and islands, like Phuket and Koh Samui.
Make your vacation more memorable as you enjoy a visit to the stunning Phi Phi Island, worldwide known for its vibrant and diverse nightlife.
Admire the surrounding 100-metre cliffs, powdery sand, and the azure waters of Maya Bay, famous for being featured in the movie “The Beach.”
Visit Monkey Beach, where you can see playful monkeys in their natural habitat and enjoy activities like swimming and snorkelling in the clear waters.
Explore the Viking Cave on Phi Phi Leh, where you can explore ancient artwork while witnessing the remarkable phenomenon of swiftlet nests.
overview:
About the tour:
Offering you an unforgettable vacation with your beloved, Phuket and Koh Samui has been a promising destination for ages. Witness the beauty of Phuket unveil right in front of your eyes with its exciting nightlife, beautiful beaches, old-world charm and so much more. Also, experience your own slice of paradise on the full-day island hopping trip that’ll introduce you to the wonders of the Phi Phi Islands. Stroll around Koh Samui’s most lively district, Chaweng, home to a number of bars and restaurants, as well as a gorgeous strip of beach. A tour that will be a perfect getaway with your beloved, a tour that promises you the best of Thailand.

know_before_you_go: You should carry your passport and visa at the time of arrival.
With the tropical climate, staying hydrated is essential. Drink bottled water and avoid tap water to prevent waterborne illnesses.

The currency used in Thailand is the Thai Baht (THB) so familiarize yourself with the current exchange rate and ensure you have enough cash or access to ATMs, especially if you plan to visit rural areas.
Adhere to designated smoking areas and respect non-smoking areas, which may include indoor spaces and certain outdoor areas.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Phuket
days.desc: Welcome to the "Pearl of Andaman," Phuket! Upon landing at Phuket Airport, you'll be driven to your hotel for check-in. After that, you can relax or explore the city at your own pace. You can head out to Ao Nang Beach and relax on its white sand while admiring the surrounding views. You can also visit the beautiful Patong Beach, Phuket Bird Park, and many more attractions. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Phi Phi Island
days.desc: Today, get ready for an excursion to the famous Phi Phi Island. From the hotel, you'll be transferred to the Royal Phuket Marina to take the speed boat to Phi Phi Island. Upon reaching there, see the caves, cliffs, and clear waters as you admire the surrounding views of the island. Next, explore Monkey Beach, followed by a visit to Koh Phi Phi Leh, and take-in the views of the landscape while enjoying water sports like snorkeling. Later, you'll be driven back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Koh Samui
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from your hotel, as you'll be driven to Donsak Pier. Upon reaching, board your ferry and enjoy a scenic journey to a beautiful island in the Gulf of Thailand, Koh Samui. Next, disembark from your ferry at Nathon Pier in Koh Samui, and you'll be driven to your hotel for check-in. Then, spend the rest of the day at leisure, where you can explore some vibrant markets like the Wharf Samui and the Fishermans Village. Later, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Leisure Day in Koh Samui
days.desc: Today, get ready to explore the beautiful Koh Samui island at your own pace. You can visit the famous Big Buddha Temple and dive into the region's rich history. Also, you can visit Wat Plai Laem to witness the 18-armed statue of Guanyin. Explore more attractions like the Secret Buddha Garden, Lad Koh Viewpoint, and more. Next, you can witness the palm-fringed beaches, like Chaweng Beach, and soak-in the beautiful sunset scenery. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Phuket
days.desc: After check-out from your hotel in Koh Samui, you'll be taken to the Nathon Pier and board your ferry for Phuket. Enjoy the journey as you soak-in the stunning seascapes along the way. Upon reaching Phuekt, board your transfer to the hotel and check-in. Afterward, you can explore the city at your own pace by spending some time at Bang Pae Waterfall or enjoying a boxing match at Patong Boxing Stadium. Later, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.desc: In the morning, pack your bag full of memories and get ready to bid farewell to Phuket. Post check-out, you'll be driven to the airport to board your flight back home, marking the end of this memorable trip.
